title: Agent trust
description: LLM o11y 101: guardrail decisions and LLM-as-a-judge scores, from gen_ai.evaluation.result events.

config.content: **Agent trust.** Built from OpenTelemetry `gen_ai.evaluation.result` events in `logs-genai.otel-*`. Judge scores (hallucination, relevance, toxicity, pii) arrive from the start. **Guardrail panels empty?** Emitting guardrail results as evaluation events is Lab 3.

data_source.query:
SET unmapped_fields="nullify";
FROM logs-genai.otel-*
| WHERE attributes.travel_planner.guardrail.action == "deny"
| STATS blocked = COUNT_DISTINCT(trace_id)

SET unmapped_fields="nullify";
FROM logs-genai.otel-*
| WHERE attributes.travel_planner.guardrail.action == "flag"
| STATS flagged = COUNT_DISTINCT(trace_id)

SET unmapped_fields="nullify";
FROM logs-genai.otel-*
| WHERE attributes.gen_ai.evaluation.name == "hallucination"
| STATS failed = COUNT(*) WHERE attributes.gen_ai.evaluation.score.label == "fail", total = COUNT(*)
| EVAL rate = ROUND(100.0 * failed / total, 1)
| KEEP rate

SET unmapped_fields="nullify";
FROM logs-genai.otel-*
| WHERE attributes.gen_ai.evaluation.name == "relevance"
| STATS relevance = AVG(attributes.gen_ai.evaluation.score.value)

SET unmapped_fields="nullify";
FROM logs-genai.otel-*
| WHERE attributes.travel_planner.guardrail.action IS NOT NULL
| STATS decisions = COUNT(*) BY guard = attributes.gen_ai.evaluation.name, action = attributes.travel_planner.guardrail.action

SET unmapped_fields="nullify";
FROM logs-genai.otel-*
| WHERE attributes.travel_planner.evaluator == "llm-judge"
| STATS score = AVG(attributes.gen_ai.evaluation.score.value) BY t = BUCKET(@timestamp, 40, ?_tstart, ?_tend), evaluation = attributes.gen_ai.evaluation.name

config.title: Failed checks: what went wrong, and where (trace_id)

data_source.query:
SET unmapped_fields="nullify";
FROM logs-genai.otel-*
| WHERE attributes.gen_ai.evaluation.score.label == "fail"
| SORT @timestamp DESC
| KEEP @timestamp, attributes.gen_ai.evaluation.name, attributes.travel_planner.guardrail.action, attributes.gen_ai.evaluation.score.value, attributes.gen_ai.evaluation.explanation, trace_id
| RENAME attributes.gen_ai.evaluation.name AS check, attributes.travel_planner.guardrail.action AS action, attributes.gen_ai.evaluation.score.value AS score, attributes.gen_ai.evaluation.explanation AS explanation
| LIMIT 50
